CoordinateSystemDescription: Head coords from digitization (MNI-Neuromag: nasion +y, LPA/RPA on x), transformed to MRI native FreeSurfer surface-RAS space via sample_audvis_raw-trans.fif (head->mri). Positions in electrodes.tsv are MRI-RAS, mm.
Source: MNE sample dataset (MNE-sample-data), subject sample: sample_audvis_raw.fif digitization
